title: Exi's Experiment #2 - Action & Adventure
description: This modpack is an action & adventure, filled with new bosses, biomes and items that'll enhance your gameplay
body:
**I do not own any of the content that are in the modpack, All work, mods, resourcepacks & shaders go to the original authors.**

This modpack was used for my experiment server where i host minecraft events/adventures, -however ofcourse, this is perfectly fine to use in singleplayer or if you want to play multiplayer but can't afford a good server, You can use this modpack to host a server using the e4mc mod in this modpack + get a dedicated IP for that session!

This modpack is also a carefully curated action & adventure modpack used in my experiment server, with the more notable mods being;

- Cataclysm - A mod that adds difficult dungeons, challenging boss-fights and powerful items.

- Ars Nouveau - allows players to craft their own spells, create magical artifacts, perform rituals, and much more. Documentation is provided entirely in-game by Patchouli. To get started with this mod, craft the Worn Notebook using a book and 1 Lapis Lazuli. You can also consult the wiki on the official mod

- Simple Voice Chat - A nice and simple mod that adds proximity chat in the server, Letting you talk to players nearby

- e4mc - a mod that lets you run a LAN world and host it to friends all around the world with a specific IP given to you by the mod

This modpack lets you play with friends all around the world on LAN singleplayer with an IP from e4mc (SVC Not guranteed to work this way), but if you do decide to use a dedicated server to play with friends, You can remove e4mc and use simple voice chat naturally and cast all your favorite spells on the bosses from Cataclysm!

If you wanna see all of the mobs! Feel free to check out the individual mods listed in the dependencies!
